content: I'll start by reading the test image to analyze the symptoms.

This strongly suggests a vascular wilt disease. Let me view a reference for Bacterial_Wilt to confirm.

The reference image for Bacterial_Wilt (Bugwood_6.jpg) is an excellent match:

- Same brown/tan coloration of wilted tissue
- Same field setting with stakes/supports still upright
- Same plastic mulch ground cover
- Rapid, complete collapse without obvious lesions on remaining green parts

The test image matches Bacterial_Wilt very closely — both show the hallmark rapid, complete wilting of the entire plant while neighboring plants remain healthy, characteristic of *Ralstonia solanacearum* infection.
